title: Licensure Examination for Teachers (LET)
disclaimer: Original practice items for educational simulation only. Not affiliated with PRC/CSC.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Under the 1987 Philippine Constitution, sovereignty resides in the people and all government authority emanates from them. Which principle does this primarily affirm?
questions.explanation: Article II expresses that sovereignty resides in the people; this is the doctrine of popular sovereignty.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Which event marked the proclamation of Philippine independence from Spain on June 12, 1898?
questions.explanation: Independence was proclaimed by Emilio Aguinaldo in Kawit, Cavite on June 12, 1898.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang HINDI kabilang sa mga pantulong na bahagi ng pananalita sa Filipino?
questions.explanation: Ang pang-uri ay pangunahing bahagi ng pananalita.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: A LET examinee scores 78, 84, and 90 on three GenEd practice sets. What is the mean score?

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Which gas is primarily responsible for the greenhouse effect that raises Earth’s average temperature?
questions.explanation: CO₂ is a major greenhouse gas.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Who wrote the novel Noli Me Tangere, a foundational text in Philippine literature and nationalism?
questions.explanation: Jose Rizal authored Noli Me Tangere (1887).

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: Which Philippine law decentralized basic education governance and strengthened school-based management?
choices: RA 4670 (Magna Carta for Public School Teachers)
questions.explanation: RA 9155 defines the framework of basic education governance and supports SBM.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: K to 12 was institutionalized in the Philippines primarily through which law?
questions.explanation: RA 10533 institutionalized the K to 12 basic education program.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: A teacher designs an assessment that mirrors real classroom and workplace tasks. Which assessment approach is this closest to?
questions.explanation: Authentic assessment emphasizes meaningful, real-world tasks.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: Which practice best supports an inclusive Philippine classroom under the spirit of Education for All?
choices: Grouping only high achievers for all activities
Using varied strategies to address learner diversity
Teaching only in English regardless of level
questions.explanation: Inclusive pedagogy differentiates instruction and respects learner diversity.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: According to Piaget, a Grade 1 learner who struggles with abstract algebra but succeeds with concrete manipulatives is likely in which stage?
questions.explanation: Concrete operational thinkers reason with concrete objects.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: RA 7836 in the Philippines primarily concerns:
choices: Professionalization of teachers / LET and PRC registration
questions.explanation: RA 7836 governs teacher licensure and related PRC processes.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: In a DepEd school with limited devices, which is the most appropriate ICT integration principle?
choices: Use tech only when every learner has a personal laptop
Align tools to learning objectives and available resources
Replace all textbooks with viral social media content
questions.explanation: Pedagogy first: select feasible tools that serve objectives.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Which government branch has the power to impeach high officials under the Philippine Constitution?
choices: The House of Representatives initiates; Senate tries
The Supreme Court both initiates and tries
The COMELEC both initiates and tries
questions.explanation: Impeachment is initiated by the House and tried by the Senate.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Choose the grammatically correct sentence:
choices: The learners was prepared for the LET.
The learners were prepared for the LET.
The learners is prepared for the LET.
The learners be prepared for the LET.
questions.explanation: Plural subject takes were.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: A teacher uses prior knowledge activation before a new history lesson on the EDSA People Power Revolution. This primarily applies which principle?
questions.explanation: Activating schema connects new content to existing knowledge.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Which is the capital city of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: Manila is the capital.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: Which Philippine basic education classroom assessment practice emphasizes both formative and summative roles?
choices: Relying solely on a single final exam
Using varied assessment evidence to improve and certify learning
Ranking only by speed of answering
questions.explanation: Multiple evidences including formative use.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Bayanihan in Filipino culture best illustrates:
questions.explanation: Bayanihan symbolizes cooperative community spirit.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: The principle that the State shall protect and promote the right of all citizens to quality education is found in:
choices: Article II and Article XIV of the 1987 Constitution
Local Government Code taxation title only
The Civil Code on property only
questions.explanation: Education rights are constitutional commitments (notably Art. XIV).

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Who has the power of general supervision over local governments under the Constitution?
questions.explanation: The President exercises general supervision over LGUs.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: Vygotsky’s Zone of Proximal Development emphasizes learning that occurs with:
choices: Scaffolding / guided support from a more knowledgeable other
questions.explanation: ZPD is the gap between independent and assisted performance.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Which Philippine agency is primarily responsible for compiling national accounts and statistics?
questions.explanation: Philippine Statistics Authority.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: Mother Tongue-Based Multilingual Education (MTB-MLE) in early grades primarily aims to:
choices: Use the learner’s language as bridge to further learning
questions.explanation: MTB-MLE uses L1 as medium/bridge in early education.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: If all licensed teachers passed the LET, and Ana is a licensed teacher, which follows?
questions.explanation: Valid categorical syllogism.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Compute 12 + 15.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Compute 27 + 18.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Compute 45 + 55.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Compute 9 + 16.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Compute 33 + 17.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: How many years is the term of a Philippine President under the 1987 Constitution?
questions.explanation: The President and Vice President are elected for a term of six years.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Which body has the exclusive power to initiate all cases of impeachment?
questions.explanation: The House of Representatives has the exclusive power to initiate impeachment cases.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: The Katipunan was founded primarily to:
questions.explanation: The Katipunan aimed at independence from Spain through revolutionary means.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: A square classroom has a perimeter of 48 m. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Side = 48/4 = 12 m; area = 12² = 144 m².

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Which organelle is known as the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria produce ATP through cellular respiration.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Choose the sentence with correct subject-verb agreement:
choices: Neither of the learners were late.
Neither of the learners was late.
Neither of the learners be late.
Neither of the learners are late.
questions.explanation: Neither takes a singular verb: was.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: A short quiz given during a lesson to check understanding is mainly:
questions.explanation: Formative assessment guides instruction while learning is ongoing.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: Spiral progression in the K to 12 curriculum means competencies are:
choices: Revisited with increasing depth and complexity
questions.explanation: Spiral progression revisits concepts with greater complexity over time.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: The most proactive classroom management approach is to:
choices: Wait for misbehavior then punish harshly
Establish clear routines and expectations early
questions.explanation: Clear routines and expectations prevent many management issues.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: Erikson’s stage most associated with adolescents seeking identity is:
questions.explanation: Adolescence is characterized by identity vs. role confusion.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: The Code of Ethics for Professional Teachers in the Philippines mainly guides:
questions.explanation: It sets ethical standards for licensed teachers.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: SAMR’s “Substitution” level means technology:
choices: Acts as a direct tool substitute with no functional change
questions.explanation: Substitution replaces a tool without changing the task’s function.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Ang “may-akda” ay tumutukoy sa:
questions.explanation: Ang may-akda ang sumulat o lumikha ng akda.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Fiscal autonomy of local governments in the Philippines is closely linked to:
choices: Power to create sources of revenue within legal limits
Supreme Court collecting all LGU taxes
questions.explanation: LGUs may create revenue sources consistent with law and fiscal autonomy.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: Scaffolding most nearly means:
choices: Temporary support that is gradually withdrawn
questions.explanation: Scaffolding provides temporary assistance toward independence.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Which value is most clearly shown when a class shares limited materials fairly?
questions.explanation: Fair sharing reflects cooperation and justice in community life.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: DepEd’s mandate in the Philippines primarily covers:
questions.explanation: DepEd oversees basic education; CHED/TESDA cover other levels.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Which island group includes Cebu and Negros?
questions.explanation: Cebu and Negros are in the Visayas.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: A teacher who reinforces desired behavior with praise is applying:
questions.explanation: Reinforcement of voluntary behavior is operant conditioning.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: Which argument is valid?
choices: All birds fly; penguins are birds; therefore penguins fly necessarily in life.
All squares are rectangles; figure A is a square; therefore A is a rectangle.
Some dogs bark; Spot is a cat; therefore Spot barks.
No conclusion can ever be valid.
questions.explanation: The second follows validly from the premises (even if empirical claims differ).

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: Reliability of a test mainly refers to:
choices: Length of the answer key only
questions.explanation: Reliability is about consistency of measurement.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: In photosynthesis, light energy is captured mainly by:
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll pigments capture light for photosynthesis.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: A curriculum map is most useful for:
choices: Aligning standards, content, and assessments over time
Replacing lesson plans entirely without goals
questions.explanation: Maps help align intended learning, teaching, and assessment.

questions.subject: General Education
questions.stem: El Filibusterismo is best described as:
choices: Rizal’s sequel novel critiquing colonial society
questions.explanation: El Filibusterismo is Rizal’s second novel continuing social critique.

questions.subject: Professional Education
questions.stem: When conflict arises, a restorative approach prioritizes:
choices: Immediate expulsion only as first step always
questions.explanation: Restorative practice focuses on accountability and repairing relationships.
